scope: every question of the 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 Preliminary Paper-I in data/pyq/mymppsc-pyq-bank.json
method: Each stored answer was re-derived from independent subject reasoning and reliable sources rather than accepted from the printed key. Questions whose answers had previously been changed, questions flagged unresolved, questions where the printed key conflicted with the stored answer, multi-answer and defective items, explanation/answer contradictions and malformed option sets were investigated first; the remainder were checked against their explanation and printed key for internal consistency.

categories.corrected: Stored answer was demonstrably wrong; changed and synchronised with the explanation, the correction manifest and the reports.
categories.ambiguous: Stem defective, evidence conflicting or more than one answer defensible; uncertainty stated and not forced to a single key.
